parameters.name: CacheTtlMax
parameters.description: The maximum TTL for cached data from an origin fetch. The value must be an integer from 30 to 86400.

parameters.name: CacheTtlMin
parameters.description: The minimum time-to-live (TTL) for cached data from an origin fetch. The value must be an integer from 30 to 86400.

parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The domain name.<props="china"> Call the [DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains) operation to query the domain name.</props>
<props="intl">Call the [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains) operation to query the domain name.</props>

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the authoritative proxy instance.<props="china"> Call the [ListCloudGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances) operation to query the instance ID.</props>
<props="intl">Call the [ListCloudGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances) operation to query the instance ID.</props>

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. The default value is zh. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: SourceDnsServer
parameters.description: A list of origin DNS servers. You can specify up to 10 servers.

sub_parameters.name: Host
sub_parameters.description: The domain name or IP address of the origin server.

sub_parameters.name: Port
sub_parameters.description: The port of the origin DNS server.

parameters.name: SourceEdns
parameters.description: SUPPORT: The origin server supports EDNS.

parameters.name: SourceProtocol
parameters.description: The protocol used for origin fetch. Valid values: TCP and UDP. The default value is UDP.
